subject: A secret confession about your Predictify account
preview_text: I wasn't going to send this, but you've earned something special. An exclusive look inside the stables.
body_paragraphs: This is going to sound strange, but I was reviewing our user data the other day. Not the bets or the picks—just how long people stick around. And your name popped up. Day 68. Honestly, that’s rare air. Most people download, use it once, and vanish. You didn’t. That means something.

So, thank you. Seriously. It’s users like you who make this app worth building. To show that appreciation, I want to give you something we don’t talk about publicly: exclusive, early access to our Trainer Intent Alerts. It’s a raw, unfiltered look at which top trainers are secretly bullish on a horse that the public odds haven’t caught up to yet. This isn't just data; it's the whisper from the saddling ring.

This insight is live right now in your app, but only for members who’ve been with us as long as you have. Head to the 'Premium Insights' tab. You’ll see a new section called 'Stable Secrets.' It’s your backstage pass. We’re talking about spotting the next big thing at Royal Ascot or the Kentucky Derby before the market moves.

Tap below to open the app and see what’s waiting in your Stable Secrets. This is my way of saying thanks for not being a ghost. P.S. What you find in there today could change how you view the 3:15 at Cheltenham entirely. It’s that powerful.
